Done. Created `src/test/org/apache/commons/cli/ParserAgentTest.java` — the only file added/changed.

## Findings about the project

- **JUnit version:** 3.8.1 only (`target/lib/junit-3.8.1.jar`; no `org.junit.*`). Matched the existing style: `extends junit.framework.TestCase`, `public static Test suite()`, `ParserAgentTest(String name)` constructor, `test*` methods, `assertTrue/assertEquals/assertNull/fail`, and the `try { … fail() } catch (SpecificException e) { … }` idiom used in `ParseTest`.
- `Parser` is abstract, so tests drive it through `BasicParser` (identity `flatten`, fully predictable) and one `GnuParser` case.

## Public API covered

`parse(Options,String[])`, `parse(…,Properties)`, `parse(…,boolean)`, `parse(…,Properties,boolean)`, and the public `processArgs(Option, ListIterator)`.

26 tests, asserting on returned `CommandLine` state and on `Option`/iterator state — not just "no exception":

- **Happy path:** flag option, option-with-argument (value + `getOptionValues` length), left-over args, GNU long option `--block-size 10 extra`.
- **Boundary:** `null` arguments array (returns empty `CommandLine`), empty array, `--` terminator (and that `--` itself isn't added to args), lone `-` treated as a plain argument.
- **Errors:** `UnrecognizedOptionException` (message checked), `MissingArgumentException` when nothing follows and when the next token is another option, `MissingOptionException` singular vs. plural message text, missing-value for `processArgs`.
- **`stopAtNonOption`:** remainder collection, unknown option swallowed as arg without throwing, unknown option *does* throw when `false`.
- **Properties:** applied to flags/args, command line wins over properties, non-truthy flag value not set.
- **Reuse:** same `Options` instance across two parses clears stale values (CLI-71) and still enforces required options on the second parse.
- **`processArgs`:** consumes values up to next option and pushes that token back, strips surrounding quotes, throws on missing value, allows missing value when `optionalArg`.

## Verification

- `defects4j compile` → `Running ant (compile) OK` / `Running ant (compile.tests) OK`
- `java -cp $(defects4j export -p cp.test) junit.textui.TestRunner org.apache.commons.cli.ParserAgentTest` → `OK (26 tests)`
